## The study

Hemmige V, Deshpande P, Norris KC, Shen JI, Erickson KF, Johansen KL, Golestaneh L. Geographic dialysis facility density and early dialysis initiation. *JAMA Network Open*. 2024;7(1):e2350009 [@hemmige2024density].

-   **Ladan Golestaneh** (senior author)
-   **Vagish Hemmige** (first author, statistical analysis and this repository)

Scientific decisions for the replication are made by Vagish Hemmige and Ladan Golestaneh.

## This repository

This repository rebuilds the published analysis from a single R Markdown file into scripts run in order by `R/main.R`, using `usRds`, `flowchart` and `tidycensus`. It accompanies a 2026 abstract on the reproducibility of USRDS research. The USRDS data are restricted and are not in the repository; the code finds them through `usRds` on the computer of an authorized analyst.

Contributions follow the rules in [`AGENTS.md`](https://github.com/VagishHemmige/Dialysis-facility-density-USRDS/blob/main/AGENTS.md); open decisions and known issues are tracked in [Issues](https://github.com/VagishHemmige/Dialysis-facility-density-USRDS/issues).

## Pages

-   [**Clinical background**](background.qmd): why the timing of dialysis and facility density matter.
-   [**Differences from the original code**](differences.qmd): every correction and open decision, with a glossary of USRDS terms.
-   [**The original R Markdown file**](original.qmd): the October 2023 analysis, as text.
-   [**Setup**](setup.qmd): packages and every constant.
-   [**Functions**](functions.qmd): tested helper functions.
-   [**1. Public area data**](download_public_data.qmd): ACS, Dartmouth Atlas and RUCA downloads.
-   [**2. USRDS patient data**](prepare_patients.qmd): Medical Evidence and Residence files through `usRds`.
-   [**3. Linking area data**](link_area_data.qmd): facility counts by date, area data and the exposure.
-   [**4. Cohort flowchart**](create_cohort.qmd): every exclusion as one `flowchart` step.
-   [**5. Density categories**](define_exposure.qmd): the five exposure categories.
-   [**6. Models**](models.qmd): Table 2 and sensitivity analyses.
-   [**Tables**](tables.qmd) and [**Figures**](figures.qmd): building and exporting the outputs.
-   [**Published figures and tables**](results.qmd): the article's Figures 1 and 2 and Tables 1 and 2, reproduced unchanged.
-   [**Published supplement**](supplement.qmd): the published eTables and eFigures, reproduced unchanged.
-   [**Classifying codes with an LLM ensemble**](classify_esrd_causes.qmd): the cause of kidney failure mapping.
